notes: *Oh that one* is read as the optative `mî`'s own fixed rendering, headed on the indefinite subject that realizes it (rules 17, 30); the competing reading marks *Oh that* a volitive frame belonging to the verb under rule 17 and leaves `mî` the bare *one*.
`yašqēnî` is a causative rendered by a light verb and a second verb, headed on the complement *drink* (rule 44).
